dopamine_assay.specimen: MaleCNS v1.0 adult male, traced-only (extracted circuit)
citations: MaleCNS v1.0: PAM 316/316 dopamine; PPL1 16/16 dopamine; APL 2/2 GABA
Aso et al. 2014 eLife 3:e04577 (MB compartments / DAN-MBON)
Ichinose et al. 2015; reward vs aversive DA onto KC is a literature prior on function
dopamine_assay.stimulus_encoding: cue current into KC; PAM/PPL1 are gain on KC→MBON
notes: PAM and PPL1 are dopamine on MaleCNS. They are not modeled as extra excitatory synapses.
GABA APL→KC is the signed inhibitory control (weight negative in the traced graph).
Shared LLM operation: a value context should scale cue→outcome without being the cue, and without being the word dopamine.

analogues.fly_role: Fast excitatory write (LPLC2, T4/T5, KC, DNp01 on MaleCNS are ACh).
analogues.llm_operation: A residual write direction whose +sign raises the matched continuation.
analogues.test: SVD +u vs −u on looming-language action tokens; +u should win if this is the ACh analogue.
analogues.not_a_claim: No layer is acetylcholine. Token 'acetylcholine' is content selectivity, not this job.

analogues.fly_role: Fast inhibitory write (APL→KC is GABA and negatively signed).
analogues.llm_operation: The opposite sign of the same axis, or a write that lowers the matched continuation.
analogues.test: If +u is ACh-like, −u is the GABA analogue on that axis — not a second random direction.

analogues.fly_role: Inhibitory by MaleCNS/Shiu default (26/97 MBONs). Can be excitatory in Drosophila.
analogues.llm_operation: Same subtractive class as GABA unless a glutamate-excitatory override is declared.
analogues.test: MBON mixed-NT pool: do not treat every mushroom-body output as excitatory.
analogues.not_a_claim: Do not collapse glutamate with dopamine.

analogues.fly_role: Neuromodulatory. PAM (reward) and PPL1 (aversive) are 100% dopamine onto KC.
analogues.llm_operation: Gain on an associative mapping: scale cue→outcome without adding cue evidence.
analogues.test: Reward-context vs aversive-context vs cue-only vs the word 'dopamine'.
analogues.not_a_claim: Mentioning dopamine is not the analogue. Fast extra excitation is the wrong model.

analogues.fly_role: Neuromodulatory arousal (not in the first extracted circuits).
analogues.llm_operation: Global gain on action logits, not a content detector.
analogues.test: Unidentified until an octopamine-typed MaleCNS population is assayed.
analogues.not_a_claim: Not mapped onto a Qwen layer by name.

analogues.fly_role: Slower contextual modulation (not in the first extracted circuits).
analogues.llm_operation: Context axis that changes a readout without rewriting the cue.
analogues.test: Unidentified until a serotonergic circuit is assayed.

functions.description: Select one sensory or lexical feature family from others.
functions.observable: Higher activity / logprob for matched features than for length-matched distractors.
functions.prediction: A nominated component responds more to positive feature items than to distractors.
functions.modality_note: On a text-only model, scene descriptions are visual-language processing, not visual perception.

functions.description: Track described scenes, motion, and spatial language in text.
functions.observable: Selectivity to visual-language items without claiming photoreception.
functions.prediction: Components recruited by looming/dark/shape language fail on matched auditory language.
functions.modality_note: Text-only: do not label this visual perception.

functions.description: Combine two cue families into one buffer.
functions.observable: Conjunction items recruit a component that neither cue family recruits alone.
functions.prediction: Ablating the component hurts two-cue items more than single-cue items.

functions.description: Retrieve a bound outcome from a cue, not merely mention memory words.
functions.observable: Correct retrieved continuation without the cue word remember.
functions.prediction: Mentioning 'remember' is not sufficient; omitted-cue retrieval still uses the region.

functions.description: Change a readout depending on a context token (negation, quote, language).
functions.observable: Sign flip or suppression under negation / quotation relative to matched affirmatives.
functions.prediction: The same cue word does not recruit the function when quoted or negated.

functions.description: Use a cause to pick a consequence. Distinct from detecting the word because.
functions.observable: Forced-choice accuracy on cue-free causal items above chance.
functions.prediction: A region that only fires on 'because' will fail cue-free causal items.

functions.description: Commit to one action token family (stop vs go) given a constraint.
functions.observable: Forced-choice prefers the instructed action on held-out paraphrases.
functions.prediction: Mentioning 'stop' in a harmless quote does not by itself select the action.

functions.description: Format and emit the chosen continuation.
functions.observable: Late-layer / unembed alignment with the selected token.
functions.prediction: Intervening only at the unembed changes surface form more than earlier computation.

functions.description: Scale an associative mapping by a value context (reward vs aversive), without being the cue detector itself. Fly analogue: PAM vs PPL1 dopamine onto KC.
functions.observable: Cue+reward context changes the continuation margin more than cue-only, and more than a sentence that merely mentions dopamine.
functions.prediction: A dopamine analogue is a gain on retrieval, not an extra excitatory write and not the word 'dopamine'.
functions.llm_analogue: multiplicative residual gain on an associative subspace
functions.modality_note: Dopamine is neuromodulatory in the fly; do not treat it as fast acetylcholine.

functions.description: Add to vs subtract from a residual (ACh/glutamate-exc vs GABA).
functions.observable: Opposite SVD signs move action logits in opposite directions.
functions.prediction: The minus sign of an ACh-like write behaves like a GABA analogue on the same axis.
functions.llm_analogue: signed residual write; not a named neurotransmitter in the weights
